exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-te kureru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てくれる matches "Verb-te kureru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てくれる.
exercises.explanation: Used when someone kindly does an action for you or your in-group.
